newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Corp Futures to sell cash gold options.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Corp Futures to sell cash gold options.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corporation Futures Ltd said on Thursday that it plans to sell yen-denominated cash gold options to private investors, starting next month.
It would be the first time such options would be available in Japan, a company spokesman said.
"Considering the recent plunge in gold prices, the needs for risk hedging appear to be growing," a spokesman for the company said.
He said the minimum trading lot was likely to be five kg. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
